description: Synthetic, committed, and network-free. One corpus asked the same questions through the built-in lexical adapter and through the qmd adapter with one retrieval layer added at a time (bm25, vector, hybrid, full), so a metric that moves can be attributed to the layer that moved it rather than to one opaque pipeline. qmd's output is replayed from recordings of the real CLI: its query expansion is a language model, and its models are about 2GB that a CI machine has no business downloading. The prose and queries are inventions.

baseline.note: Layer attribution, not a regression guard for ranking constants. Measured on 2026-07-29, qmd 2.5.3: the lexical adapter and qmd's bm25 mode both ABSTAIN on the paraphrase question, whose words appear nowhere in the document that answers it — that is the gap the plan called unmeasurable, and it is now measured. vector answers it at nDCG@10 1.0000 and MRR@10 1.0000. hybrid and full answer it at nDCG@10 0.3869 and MRR@10 0.2000, with the right document ranked LAST of five. That last number is the finding, and it is not a defect in the qmd adapter: relevance is a multiplicative factor in fusion, a pure paraphrase measures 0 under Recall's shared lexical definition, so every candidate in those two modes scores 0, the source's own ordering is discarded, and the tie-break decides. vector scores 1.0 only because qmd returned one result there. Making paraphrase aboutness comparable across sources is the work this pack exists to justify; until it lands, a rise in mode-hybrid or mode-full here is that work landing, not this pack drifting. Two things the pack deliberately does NOT assert. It does not assert the reranked modes' off-corpus behaviour — they return unrelated documents at scores a caller cannot tell apart from a real hit, which is recorded in the adapter's search-ranked conformance transcript; asserting today's false positive as expected would make an improvement read as a regression. And it judges rank rather than relevance numbers, because a paraphrase hit's relevance is 0 by that definition and rank is what can honestly be graded. AMENDED 2026-07-29, same day, after the live rollout: vector mode now measures relevance on qmd's cosine similarity (quantized to four fixed decimals) instead of recomputing it lexically, because the lexical measure is 0 on every true paraphrase by construction and the core's relevance floor was withholding exactly the results this comparison exists to surface. The retrieval metrics above did not move: mode-vector already scored nDCG@10 1.0000 because a floor may withhold but may not abstain, so the candidate was shown either way. What moved is that it now clears the floor on its own rather than surviving a fallback, and a ninth case was added — off-corpus-vector-009 — because that mode's admission floor is qmd's own cosine threshold: a noise query returns an empty list and Recall abstains, which is the statement hybrid and full cannot make. mode-hybrid and mode-full are unchanged and still keep the lexical recompute; their scores are rank-normalized, so rank 1 is 1.0 whatever matched.
